title: D2Pruner: Debiased Importance and Structural Diversity for MLLM Token Pruning
selection_reason: D2Pruner prunes visual tokens in MLLMs by combining a debiased attention-based importance score with maximal-independent-set selection over a spatial-semantic hybrid graph, reducing LLaVA-1.5-7B FLOPs by 74.2% while retaining 99.2% performance and sustaining 85.7% at 90% token reduction on InternVL localization; a direct inference-acceleration technique for multimodal LLMs.
